summary: Defined a standard-library Kanban architecture, its API contract, and non-overlapping implementation boundaries.

new_tasks.title: Create `database.py` containing SQLite connection setup, schema initialization, and task repository functions; own only this file and the runtime `.db` file.
Create `server.py` containing the `http.server` request router, JSON responses, static-file serving, and REST handlers; call the repository API from `database.py` without editing it.
Create `index.html` as the sole static frontend file with vanilla JS for loading, creating, editing, moving, and deleting tasks through `/api/tasks`; do not edit Python files.

messages.content: Architecture contract is ready: SQLite repository (`database.py`), HTTP server (`server.py`), and single-file UI (`index.html`) have exclusive ownership boundaries.

REST contract: GET /api/tasks; POST /api/tasks body {title,description?,status?}; PUT /api/tasks/{id} body may include title,description,status; DELETE /api/tasks/{id}. Return task objects {id,title,description,status,created_at,updated_at}; statuses are todo, in_progress, done.
Use the contract GET/POST /api/tasks and PUT/DELETE /api/tasks/{id}; display statuses todo, in_progress, done as Todo, In Progress, Done. Send JSON and refresh state after mutations.

Repository contract should expose initialize_database(), list_tasks(), create_task(title, description, status), update_task(id, fields), and delete_task(id). Validate/persist only statuses todo, in_progress, done.

decisions: Use Python `http.server` for REST routing and static serving, `sqlite3` for persistence, and `json` for payloads/responses; no external packages.
Store tasks in SQLite with id, title, description, status, created_at, and updated_at. Title is required; description defaults to empty; status defaults to `todo`.
Serve `index.html` from the same origin as the API to avoid CORS requirements.
API errors use JSON with an `error` field and appropriate 400, 404, or 405 status codes.
The task lifecycle permits moving directly among `todo`, `in_progress`, and `done`; any invalid status is rejected with 400.
